description: Make captions for images from their metadata (Object > Captions > Caption Setup, Generate Live Caption, Generate Static Caption): a text frame beside each item with a live metadata caption variable, or its text; or convert live captions to static text (Convert to Static Caption). Can number captions through a numbering list that runs across stories (Figure 1, Figure 2...).

group.description: Group each caption with its item

mode.description: live: caption follows the metadata; static: plain text; convert_to_static: target is caption frames whose live captions become text

numbering.description: Number captions (needs paragraphStyle): the style numbers paragraphs through this list

acrossDocuments.description: Continue numbering from the previous document in a book

expression.description: Number format, e.g. "Figure ^#: " (^# is the number)

list.description: Numbering list name, created when missing (e.g. "Figures")

offset.description: Gap between item and caption in mm (default 2)

position.description: Where the caption frame goes (default below)

size.description: Caption frame height (below/above) or width (left/right) in mm (default 10)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

variableName.description: Name of the caption variable to use or create (default "Caption: <metadataField>")

name: generate_captions
title: Generate Captions
